snippet.title: Crossover Collab – Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
It's finally time! Are you excited? Crossover Collab is out now!

Play here: https://gamebanana.com/mods/637482
Installation tutorial: https://youtu.be/KqD3COuVyLI

Report any issues in our discord server: https://discord.gg/kyJ7gp4bTf

Crossover Collab is an unofficial collaborative mod for the game Celeste (2018) that was developed over the course of the past 3 years. It is free and available on GameBanana. 

Music: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z4PcWQD0c8w

( Trailer by https://www.youtube.com/@ashley_bl )
